name: genocode
description: Design GenoCode creatures: tools to check, draw and save them.
long_description: Describe a creature, and Claude writes it in GenoCode, checks it, draws it, fixes what's wrong and saves it as a .genie file. Add the genocode-creatures skill too, so Claude knows the language and the rules for making creatures. Open saved creatures in the GenoCode app: https://genocode.piorek.co.za/app/

tools.name: check_creature
tools.description: Check a creature for errors and warnings.

tools.name: render_creature
tools.description: Draw a creature, a variant or several sides of it.

tools.name: list_genes
tools.description: List the genes the user can change.

tools.name: check_family
tools.description: Check that a creature and its variants morph, breed and dance smoothly.

tools.name: save_creature
tools.description: Save the finished creature as a .genie file.

prompts.name: design_creature
prompts.description: Design a GenoCode creature from a description.
prompts.text: Follow the genocode-creatures skill, and use the GenoCode tools to check, draw and save the creature. Design this creature: ${arguments.description}

creatures_folder.title: Folder for creatures
creatures_folder.description: Where saved creatures go, as .genie files.
